title: Saved opportunities can be deleted: one door and a bulk action, refused with DEMO_BUILD_RUNNING while a demo builds, and a Delete button with a confirmation in the bulk bar and the Inspector
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/site/tracy-website-opportunities/test/client-delete.test.mjs

S2: Record the exit code, the "# tests", "# pass", "# fail", "# skipped" lines and the result of each test whose name starts with: "a live demo site"; "the confirmation"; "the rows left after a delete"; "one row goes through its own door"; "several rows go through the bulk door".

S3 (Postgres-backed part, not part of this case run): apps/tracy-web/test/website-opportunities-delete.test.mjs covers DELETE /api/website-opportunities/:id, the bulk delete action and the 409 DEMO_BUILD_RUNNING refusal against a database.
expect: S1 exits 0 with "# fail 0" and "# skipped 0", and "# pass" equal to "# tests".

Every named test in S2 is "ok": the confirmation lists the picked rows in screen order and counts how many have a live demo site; a single row goes through its own door and NOT_FOUND counts as gone; several rows go through the bulk door and a failed press keeps its request id for the retry; the rows left keep their order.
fence: Mechanism of the client delete model and its two doors. The server refusal while a demo builds is covered by the Postgres-backed apps/tracy-web/test/website-opportunities-delete.test.mjs, not graded here.

tests: the rows left after a delete
one row goes through its own door
several rows go through the bulk door
